budget_declared_before_requests.scope: One catalog-first cycle for HyperX QuadCast 2S Black (catalog row 6985, seller article 9A273AA). No Xbox, Samsung, PlayStation, or Kingston work; no general HyperX/brand census.
budget_declared_before_requests.why_a_fresh_request_is_needed_despite_of: Stage 8.1's fixture for this exact URL is a sanitized structural CONTRACT (JSON-LD paths, DOM-semantic markers, signatures) by this project's 'no raw HTML persisted' rule -- it proves WHICH fields exist and that their shape is stable, but never stores the field VALUES (actual name/spec/image text). Building an exportable card requires the values, which requires one bounded, allowlisted re-fetch of the same already-confirmed URL -- not a new discovery.
budget_declared_before_requests.allowed_hosts_reason: The exact host already confirmed official and live-fetched in Stage 8.1 (fixture 1dd3897450ff08ae7bde27d72cc20a93e140ee61652f79dd96799d271d331099.json, is_product_page=true).

If either is fetched and itself links to a PDF, that PDF's host will get its own explicit budget line (Stage 8.6 bounded-document convention) before any request to it -- not predeclared speculatively now.

extraction_contract_reused_from_stage8_1.applicability_check_before_use: Each of these contract paths is only applied to THIS stage's own freshly-fetched page after independently confirming its CMS fingerprint (generic_json_ld_product + shopify) matches Stage 8.1's signature -- the contract is not assumed to transfer without that check.

budget_declared_before_requests.robots_txt_policy: hyperx.com/robots.txt fetched first, before the product page, honoring any Disallow rules under User-agent: *.

pdf_budget_if_discovered.note: Not predeclared with a specific host/size, because no PDF URL is known yet. If discovered via an already-fetched hyperx.com/support page, a separate explicit budget reusing Stage 8.6's Range-aware, completeness-classified fetch will be declared before any request to it.

stop_conditions: HTTP 403/429/challenge_confirmed on hyperx.com -> stop that host, record the gap (challenge_suspected alone, per Stage 8.1's own precedent, does not stop -- only a confirmed block does)
redirect off the allowed host(s) -> aborted, not followed
robots.txt disallows the exact product/support path -> skip, record why
explicit_non_goals: No brute-forcing of URLs, model codes, or PDF filenames
No wide HyperX/brand census beyond this one catalog row
No Xbox/Samsung/PlayStation/Kingston network activity this stage
